description: Search and read the 7,499 released Jeffrey Epstein emails directly in the Gmail-style archive UI.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read a single structured snapshot of the current page, including readiness and available data. Read-only; never navigates or interacts. Other tools compose this reader through browser.webmcp.exec.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search the Epstein email archive by keyword using the site search box. Returns the top matching email threads (subject, sender, date, preview, doc id).

tools.name: open_result
tools.description: Open the Nth row (0-based) from the last search_emails result list by clicking it, then return the thread content. Prefer this over open_thread — indexes come straight from the last search.

tools.name: open_thread
tools.description: Open an email thread by doc id in the archive UI and return its rendered content (sender, date, subject, body text).

tools.name: get_current_view
tools.description: Read the email thread currently open in the archive view, without navigating. Returns sender, date, subject and body text.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List the curated topic categories shown in the archive sidebar (Asking for advice, Introductions, Damage control, Epstein & Brunel).

tools.name: list_people
tools.description: List the notable people with dedicated archive pages (Ghislaine Maxwell, Bill Gates, Prince Andrew, Elon Musk, …) with their slugs for browse_person.

tools.name: next_thread
tools.description: Click the "Next thread" pager on a thread view to walk through the result list one email at a time (e.g. a 50-message FBI thread). Pass steps to jump several at once in long threads (e.g. the 968-message Brunel thread).

tools.name: prev_thread
tools.description: Click the "Previous thread" pager to step back in the current list. Pass steps to jump several at once.

tools.name: browse_person
tools.description: Open a person's archive page (all their emails) by slug from list_people, e.g. ghislaine-maxwell, bill-gates.

tools.name: filter_by_date
tools.description: Filter the current inbox/search view by date using the site’s Date control. Provide after and/or before as YYYY-MM-DD. Works on the inbox home view (open go_home first if you are on a thread page).

tools.name: open_message_app
tools.description: Switch from the email archive to the jmail.world JMessage app (/messages) — the iMessage-style text conversations, a different app with its own toolset (search_messages, open_conversation, …). After it runs, the system prompt's <current_page_webmcp> list swaps to the JMessage tools.

tools.name: clear_date_filter
tools.description: Clear the active date filter and restore the full list (clicks the site’s Clear button). No-op with a note when no filter is active. On a thread page, call go_home first.

tools.name: browse_folder
tools.description: Switch to a sidebar folder: inbox, starred, unredactions, sent, attachments, or activity. Always returns { kind, url, page_title, total, count, results, view }. Email list folders use kind="list", rows in results, and view=null; attachments and activity use kind="view", empty results, count=0, and a page snapshot in view.

tools.name: browse_topic
tools.description: Open a curated topic page by slug from list_topics, e.g. damage-control, epstein-brunel-collaboration.

tools.name: go_home
tools.description: Navigate back to the main inbox view of the archive.
